description: A device's seen marks on a herdr-core Host (ADR 0033), written by the app's HerdrCoreSeenMarkFile over SFTP into the Host Helper's directory and read by the Helper's seen-marks.js. Each device has one file, named from its Notification Key id and never from a Terminal address. `files` holds what the app writes byte for byte, and what the Helper reads back: `core` is the core the marks belong to, and a mark is one Terminal's `terminal`, `turn` and status `word`, with no `word` for a Terminal that has reported nothing. `unreadable` holds files the Helper reads as no marks at all, which leaves their Agents counted as Done. `done` holds whether a device with `mark` counts an Agent whose latest finished turn is `ended` as Done.

files.name: several Terminals in address order, one with no report yet, under a second key

unreadable.name: a version this Helper does not read

done.name: no mark leaves the turn Done
done.source: ADR 0033: a mark that fails to write leaves that Agent counted as Done

done.name: a mark of the turn that ended withholds it
done.source: ADR 0033: the app marks the turn that ended

done.name: a mark of an idle that ended a turn withholds it
done.source: ADR 0033: Working to Idle ends a turn for a program not known to report done

done.name: a mark from before the turn ended leaves it Done
done.source: ADR 0033: Done counts a turn that ended after the device's last mark

done.name: a mark while Working, at the count before the end, leaves it Done
done.source: ADR 0033: leaving Working moves the count

done.name: an Agent opened while Blocked has not seen the Done that follows
done.source: HerdrCoreTurnState.Mark: the word tells two points at one count apart

done.name: an Agent opened in Error has not seen the Done that follows
done.source: HerdrCoreTurnState.Mark: the word tells two points at one count apart

done.name: a mark of idle at the same count, after a key turned done into idle, withholds it
done.source: HerdrCoreTurnState.markSeen: with no ended turn known to the app it marks where the Agent stands

done.name: a mark from a later count withholds it
done.source: ADR 0033: Done counts a turn that ended after the device's last mark
